newsitem.title: JAPAN: Bandai ups dividend forecast due to 'tamagotchi'.
newsitem.headline: Bandai ups dividend forecast due to 'tamagotchi'.

text.p: Bandai Co Ltd said on Thursday that it had raised its dividend forecast for the year to March 31, 1997, partly due to the popularity of its "tamagotchi" virtual pet toy.

"We will pay a five yen special dividend because tamagotchi's a big hit. We have also raised our ordinary dividend forecast for the second half of 1996/97 to 15 yen from our previous forecast of 10 yen, aiming to return a bigger profit to our shareholders," Bandai said in a statement.
The company paid a 10 yen interim dividend for the first half of 1996/97.
Bandai said earlier on Thursday that it had raised its forecast for the total dividend in 1996/97 to 30 yen from its previous forecast of 20 yen.
It paid a total dividend of 29 yen in 1995/96.
